from pathlib import Path
import json,os,sys
from di_dmpa_gate1c_v3.durable import read,verify,sha256,write_new,now
plan=json.loads(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(plan['global_output']);index=[]
for source in plan['sources']:
 root=Path(source['remote_root']);a=source['audit'];m=verify(root)
 assert m['content_sha256']==a['content_sha256'] and sha256(root/'PRIVATE_BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json')==a['manifest_sha256']
 assert read(root/'PROCESS_EXIT.json')['actual_child_exit_code']==source['expected_exit']
 dest=out/'scopes'/source['name'];dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
 for entry in [*m['entries'],dict(path='PRIVATE_BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json')]:
  rel=Path(entry['path']);target=dest/rel;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);os.link(root/rel,target)
 index.append(dict(source,relative_root=str(dest.relative_to(out)),verified_at=now()))
 print(json.dumps(dict(linked_scope=source['name'],files=m['files'],bytes=m['bytes'])),flush=True)
authority=Path(sys.argv[2]);target=out/'authority';target.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for path in authority.iterdir():
 assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
 os.link(path,target/path.name)
write_new(out/'COMPLETE_ROUTE_INDEX.json',dict(plan,scopes=index,status='COMPLETE_VERIFIED_SOURCE_SCOPES',hardlinks_preserve_exact_bytes=True,model_forwards=0))
